integrity: Results are supported by a direct analytic proof and executable exact polynomial checks. The same-model review has been performed; independent audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The absence and convergence assertions are for bounded forward or complete trajectories, not arbitrary trajectories. The opposite-sign condition is a sharp uniform possibility boundary, not existence for every choice of remaining coefficients. The 2015 periodic-bifurcation study was available only in abstract, and full historical novelty remains subject to independent literature comparison.
title: Sharp recurrence exclusion and oscillator realizability in six-parameter quadratic jerk flows
